scope: Actual selected server push/SSE handlers extracted into VM, with production auth and ownership modules; synthetic storage, credentials, subscriptions, clocks and responses; no network or whole-app import.

failedCases: endpoint-only unsubscribe by another authenticated operator is denied without a storage write
subscribe takeover with endpoint but unrelated valid subscription keys is denied atomically
both subscription auth and public-key proofs are required for subscribe and unsubscribe migration
same-browser key possession permits reauthentication migration and then denies the previous actor endpoint-only access
unsubscribe migration proof is bound to the exact endpoint selected for removal
actual SSE handler independently refuses missing, non-browser, expired and invalid authorization
SSE expires at its exact opening capability deadline and clears heartbeat, timeout and client map

limitations: Baseline replaces only the extracted server source; the current auth/ownership modules remain external, deliberately isolating handler regressions.
Replacement cleanup and backpressure already passed on baseline; they are preserved behavior checks.
No live calls, push deliveries, service deployment or device/audio test was performed.
ownershipReview: Signed current actor may update its row. Reauthentication migration additionally requires the same endpoint plus both exact existing subscription key bytes; the 16-byte auth value is secret possession evidence, while p256dh is public and binds the subscription. Endpoint-only requests, invalid actors and mismatched/missing keys are rejected before writes. No credentials are logged in tested paths.

notificationReview.scope: Fixed-origin/path/method wrapper and push-only cookie auth, no mutation replay; reset requires authenticated server acknowledgement before local unsubscribe.
findingsSentToRoot: enable() should require body.ok === true before committing Hub setup.
refresh() wording should describe browser permission/subscription rather than imply fresh server acknowledgement.
